meta.title: Irreverent Gluttony - 6
meta.description: Grand words and elegant phrasing cannot hide the emptiness of your heart.

units.rawText: Tell me, Canon. Just who am I?
units.displayText: Tell me, Canon. Just who am I?

spans.text: Tell me, Canon. Just who am I?

units.rawText: ...I have already given you the answer.
units.displayText: ...I have already given you the answer.

spans.text: ...I have already given you the answer.

units.rawText: You already have your own conclusions, but you reject them as you deem them far too ridiculous.
units.displayText: You already have your own conclusions, but you reject them as you deem them far too ridiculous.

spans.text: You already have your own conclusions, but you reject them as you deem them far too ridiculous.

units.rawText: I'm not in the mood to go around in circles with you. I'm only here for the truth.
units.displayText: I'm not in the mood to go around in circles with you. I'm only here for the truth.

spans.text: I'm not in the mood to go around in circles with you. I'm only here for the truth.

units.rawText: Your permissions end here. Any further action is a breach of boundaries.
units.displayText: Your permissions end here. Any further action is a breach of boundaries.

spans.text: Your permissions end here. Any further action is a breach of boundaries.

units.rawText: It would be in your future interests to leave before the guards patrol this area again.
units.displayText: It would be in your future interests to leave before the guards patrol this area again.

spans.text: It would be in your future interests to leave before the guards patrol this area again.

units.rawText: Ah, no need to worry about that.
units.displayText: Ah, no need to worry about that.

spans.text: Ah, no need to worry about that.

units.rawText: She spoke in a relaxed, casual tone.
units.displayText: She spoke in a relaxed, casual tone.

spans.text: She spoke in a relaxed, casual tone.

units.rawText: I took care of all of them so our conversation wouldn't be interrupted.
units.displayText: I took care of all of them so our conversation wouldn't be interrupted.

spans.text: I took care of all of them so our conversation wouldn't be interrupted.

units.rawText: Ah, if you don't believe me, you can verify what I'm saying with those abilities of yours.
units.displayText: Ah, if you don't believe me, you can verify what I'm saying with those abilities of yours.

spans.text: Ah, if you don't believe me, you can verify what I'm saying with those abilities of yours.

units.rawText: It is anathema to kill your Sanctifier kin, Eucharist. You will be subjected to endless judgment...
units.displayText: It is anathema to kill your Sanctifier kin, Eucharist. You will be subjected to endless judgment...

spans.text: It is anathema to kill your Sanctifier kin, Eucharist. You will be subjected to endless judgment...

units.rawText: I'm not that stupid.
units.displayText: I'm not that stupid.

spans.text: I'm not that stupid.

units.rawText: Killing another Sanctifier is a sin indeed, but bestowing upon them glorious sacrifice is not only no transgression, but something to be thanked for.
units.displayText: Killing another Sanctifier is a sin indeed, but bestowing upon them glorious sacrifice is not only no transgression, but something to be thanked for.

spans.text: Killing another Sanctifier is a sin indeed, but bestowing upon them glorious sacrifice is not only no transgression, but something to be thanked for.

units.rawText: You...
units.displayText: You...

spans.text: You...

units.rawText: Before doing anything, I already Entropized them...
units.displayText: Before doing anything, I already Entropized them...

spans.text: Before doing anything, I already Entropized them...

units.rawText: Yes, with my very own hands.
units.displayText: Yes, with my very own hands.

spans.text: Yes, with my very own hands.

units.rawText: Malevolent energies ebb around the girl's fingertips. She sneers as she looks at the silent Canon, discarding her previous disguise.
units.displayText: Malevolent energies ebb around the girl's fingertips. She sneers as she looks at the silent Canon, discarding her previous disguise.

spans.text: Malevolent energies ebb around the girl's fingertips. She sneers as she looks at the silent Canon, discarding her previous disguise.

units.rawText: ...I think we can put an end to the act here, Lord Eosphorus.
units.displayText: ...I think we can put an end to the act here, Lord Eosphorus.

spans.text: ...I think we can put an end to the act here, Lord Eosphorus.

units.rawText: Or would you rather continue to speak to me via the Canon as a mouthpiece?
units.displayText: Or would you rather continue to speak to me via the Canon as a mouthpiece?

spans.text: Or would you rather continue to speak to me via the Canon as a mouthpiece?

units.rawText: A powerful presence's footsteps can be heard behind Eucharist. She does not turn around, only smiling crookedly at the emptiness in the middle of the Sacred Canon.
units.displayText: A powerful presence's footsteps can be heard behind Eucharist. She does not turn around, only smiling crookedly at the emptiness in the middle of the Sacred Canon.

spans.text: A powerful presence's footsteps can be heard behind Eucharist. She does not turn around, only smiling crookedly at the emptiness in the middle of the Sacred Canon.

units.rawText: I don't care for your plans, nor do I wish to know them, but you can count me in.
units.displayText: I don't care for your plans, nor do I wish to know them, but you can count me in.

spans.text: I don't care for your plans, nor do I wish to know them, but you can count me in.

units.rawText: If I can make this boring world a little interesting, even my life is a small price to pay.
units.displayText: If I can make this boring world a little interesting, even my life is a small price to pay.

spans.text: If I can make this boring world a little interesting, even my life is a small price to pay.

units.rawText: <color=red>??, ????</color>
Where... is this? Why is everything all black...
units.displayText: Where... is this? Why is everything all black...

spans.text: Where... is this? Why is everything all black...

units.rawText: Electra? Are you here, Electra? Can you hear me?
units.displayText: Electra? Are you here, Electra? Can you hear me?

spans.text: Electra? Are you here, Electra? Can you hear me?

units.rawText: The girl sits up, yelling into the endless darkness.
units.displayText: The girl sits up, yelling into the endless darkness.

spans.text: The girl sits up, yelling into the endless darkness.

units.rawText: No one's here...
units.displayText: No one's here...

spans.text: No one's here...

units.rawText: She moves to get up and look around, but she hears the sound of footsteps behind her.
units.displayText: She moves to get up and look around, but she hears the sound of footsteps behind her.

spans.text: She moves to get up and look around, but she hears the sound of footsteps behind her.

units.rawText: Electra? Is that you?
units.displayText: Electra? Is that you?

spans.text: Electra? Is that you?

units.rawText: She is greeted with the sight of another her.
units.displayText: She is greeted with the sight of another her.

spans.text: She is greeted with the sight of another her.

units.rawText: Another... me?
units.displayText: Another... me?

spans.text: Another... me?

units.rawText: Good to meet you, Alcyone.
units.displayText: Good to meet you, Alcyone.

spans.text: Good to meet you, Alcyone.

units.rawText: I have seen you in the records and in my dreams plenty of times, but it's the first time we've spoken face to face, right?
units.displayText: I have seen you in the records and in my dreams plenty of times, but it's the first time we've spoken face to face, right?

spans.text: I have seen you in the records and in my dreams plenty of times, but it's the first time we've spoken face to face, right?

units.rawText: ...Who are you? Why do I smell the Entropic stench on you?
units.displayText: ...Who are you? Why do I smell the Entropic stench on you?

spans.text: ...Who are you? Why do I smell the Entropic stench on you?

units.rawText: Eh? Noticed already?
units.displayText: Eh? Noticed already?

spans.text: Eh? Noticed already?

units.rawText: My apologies, it appears I've gotten a little too excited.
units.displayText: My apologies, it appears I've gotten a little too excited.

spans.text: My apologies, it appears I've gotten a little too excited.

units.rawText: Eucharist only lightly touches her face, not intending to hide the mirth on her face at all despite the hostile response.
units.displayText: Eucharist only lightly touches her face, not intending to hide the mirth on her face at all despite the hostile response.

spans.text: Eucharist only lightly touches her face, not intending to hide the mirth on her face at all despite the hostile response.

units.rawText: I suppose I am your replacement, currently perfectly executing my duties as a Greater Sanctifier.
units.displayText: I suppose I am your replacement, currently perfectly executing my duties as a Greater Sanctifier.

spans.text: I suppose I am your replacement, currently perfectly executing my duties as a Greater Sanctifier.

units.rawText: Ridiculous! How could someone like you be a Sanctifier?!
units.displayText: Ridiculous! How could someone like you be a Sanctifier?!

spans.text: Ridiculous! How could someone like you be a Sanctifier?!

units.rawText: Yeah, you're right. How could I be a Sanctifier?
units.displayText: Yeah, you're right. How could I be a Sanctifier?

spans.text: Yeah, you're right. How could I be a Sanctifier?

units.rawText: That is why you are here, Alcyone.
units.displayText: That is why you are here, Alcyone.

spans.text: That is why you are here, Alcyone.

units.rawText: The darkness around them begins to surge.
units.displayText: The darkness around them begins to surge.

spans.text: The darkness around them begins to surge.

units.rawText: Alcyone suddenly realizes that the darkness around her is a silt-like substance, moving as if it was alive. It wriggles towards her, painting her pure-white garb its color.
units.displayText: Alcyone suddenly realizes that the darkness around her is a silt-like substance, moving as if it was alive. It wriggles towards her, painting her pure-white garb its color.

spans.text: Alcyone suddenly realizes that the darkness around her is a silt-like substance, moving as if it was alive. It wriggles towards her, painting her pure-white garb its color.

units.rawText: Damn it!
units.displayText: Damn it!

spans.text: Damn it!

units.rawText: She attempts to summon her weapon, only to find no purchase. Her hand comes into contact with the grime and begins to be swallowed bit by bit.
units.displayText: She attempts to summon her weapon, only to find no purchase. Her hand comes into contact with the grime and begins to be swallowed bit by bit.

spans.text: She attempts to summon her weapon, only to find no purchase. Her hand comes into contact with the grime and begins to be swallowed bit by bit.

units.rawText: N-No...
units.displayText: N-No...

spans.text: N-No...

units.rawText: The girl resists with all her might, but she is soon dragged down by a hand extending from the muck.
units.displayText: The girl resists with all her might, but she is soon dragged down by a hand extending from the muck.

spans.text: The girl resists with all her might, but she is soon dragged down by a hand extending from the muck.

units.rawText: Without her powers, Alcyone is but a normal girl. She tries to peel away the grime on her body with the most primal of methods, but it is all for naught as she sinks deeper and deeper.
units.displayText: Without her powers, Alcyone is but a normal girl. She tries to peel away the grime on her body with the most primal of methods, but it is all for naught as she sinks deeper and deeper.

spans.text: Without her powers, Alcyone is but a normal girl. She tries to peel away the grime on her body with the most primal of methods, but it is all for naught as she sinks deeper and deeper.

units.rawText: Ah... this sound of desperation is music to the ears.
units.displayText: Ah... this sound of desperation is music to the ears.

spans.text: Ah... this sound of desperation is music to the ears.

units.rawText: Do not worry, it will not take long for me to consume you. After that, I shall be whole as a Sanctifier.
units.displayText: Do not worry, it will not take long for me to consume you. After that, I shall be whole as a Sanctifier.

spans.text: Do not worry, it will not take long for me to consume you. After that, I shall be whole as a Sanctifier.

units.rawText: So, any last words you'd like to say?
units.displayText: So, any last words you'd like to say?

spans.text: So, any last words you'd like to say?

units.rawText: Gah...
units.displayText: Gah...

spans.text: Gah...

units.rawText: We... hone our blades in the darkness, we defend order in the face of chaos, we bear a light in the long night.
units.displayText: We... hone our blades in the darkness, we defend order in the face of chaos, we bear a light in the long night.

spans.text: We... hone our blades in the darkness, we defend order in the face of chaos, we bear a light in the long night.

units.rawText: Tsk...
units.displayText: Tsk...

spans.text: Tsk...

units.rawText: We must not abuse our power because we are strong, and neither can we abandon our responsibilities because we are weak.
units.displayText: We must not abuse our power because we are strong, and neither can we abandon our responsibilities because we are weak.

spans.text: We must not abuse our power because we are strong, and neither can we abandon our responsibilities because we are weak.

units.rawText: Stupid till the end... and here I wanted to make it a little less painful.
units.displayText: Stupid till the end... and here I wanted to make it a little less painful.

spans.text: Stupid till the end... and here I wanted to make it a little less painful.

units.rawText: At her gesture, the black muck fully swallows the girl named Alcyone. She watches as the lone extended hand begging for help slowly sinks into the corroding depths of despair.
units.displayText: At her gesture, the black muck fully swallows the girl named Alcyone. She watches as the lone extended hand begging for help slowly sinks into the corroding depths of despair.

spans.text: At her gesture, the black muck fully swallows the girl named Alcyone. She watches as the lone extended hand begging for help slowly sinks into the corroding depths of despair.

units.rawText: And then...
units.displayText: And then...

spans.text: And then...

units.rawText: Gulp~
units.displayText: Gulp~

spans.text: Gulp~

units.rawText: She swallows the being known as Alcyone's past in one mouthful, stamping her feet at the sheer deliciousness of this unsampled flavor.
units.displayText: She swallows the being known as Alcyone's past in one mouthful, stamping her feet at the sheer deliciousness of this unsampled flavor.

spans.text: She swallows the being known as Alcyone's past in one mouthful, stamping her feet at the sheer deliciousness of this unsampled flavor.

units.rawText: <color=purple>...Ah, so despair had such an enchanting taste all along?</color>
units.displayText: ...Ah, so despair had such an enchanting taste all along?

spans.text: ...Ah, so despair had such an enchanting taste all along?

units.rawText: No wonder you named me Eucharist... Eosphorus, you really are petty.
units.displayText: No wonder you named me Eucharist... Eosphorus, you really are petty.

spans.text: No wonder you named me Eucharist... Eosphorus, you really are petty.

units.rawText: As if finished with dessert, she rises elegantly to her feet, walking towards the light.
units.displayText: As if finished with dessert, she rises elegantly to her feet, walking towards the light.

spans.text: As if finished with dessert, she rises elegantly to her feet, walking towards the light.

units.rawText: <color=purple>I hope you will be equally succulent when the time comes...</color>
units.displayText: I hope you will be equally succulent when the time comes...

spans.text: I hope you will be equally succulent when the time comes...

units.rawText: <color=purple>Big Sis Angelus.</color>
units.displayText: Big Sis Angelus.

spans.text: Big Sis Angelus.

units.rawText: That's all you have to say?
units.displayText: That's all you have to say?

spans.text: That's all you have to say?
